questions.q: What is Actoos Jobs?
questions.a: Actoos Jobs is the leading recruitment platform in Mali and West Africa. We connect qualified candidates with local and international companies. You can search for jobs, apply easily, and track your applications. Recruiters can post jobs, manage applications, and schedule interviews, all for free with a premium subscription option.

questions.q: Is registration free?
questions.a: Yes, registration and basic use are completely free for candidates. Companies can also create a free account and post a limited number of jobs. Paid plans are available for advanced features (more jobs, increased visibility, etc.).

questions.q: How do I create an account?
questions.a: Click on 'Register' at the top right of the site. You can choose a Candidate or Company account. Fill in the form with your email and a password, or quickly log in with Google. Your account will be created instantly.

questions.q: How do I apply for a job?
questions.a: Browse jobs from the 'Jobs' page. Click on a job to see the details, then on 'Apply'. If you haven't completed your profile yet, we will invite you to do so to optimize your chances. Once your application is sent, the company is immediately notified.

questions.q: What is the matching score?
questions.a: It's an estimate of the match between your profile and a job. The higher the score, the more your skills, experience, and salary expectations match what the employer is looking for. It helps you identify the most promising jobs for you.

questions.q: Can I save jobs for later?
questions.a: Absolutely. Click the heart at the top right of the job to add it to your favorites. Find them in your dashboard, under 'Saved jobs'.

questions.q: How do job alerts work?
questions.a: From your dashboard, go to 'Job alerts'. Define your criteria (keywords, city, category, minimum salary, frequency). You will receive an email as soon as a matching job is posted.

questions.q: What should I do if I encounter a technical problem?
questions.a: You can contact us via the contact form (Contact page) or report inappropriate content directly from the job. Our team responds quickly.

questions.q: How do I create a company profile?
questions.a: After creating a 'Company' type account, go to your dashboard and click on 'Create my company'. Fill in the requested information (name, industry, description, logo, etc.). Your company will be submitted for validation by our team. Once validated, you can post jobs.

questions.q: Why is my company pending validation?
questions.a: To ensure the quality and reliability of the offers, we manually verify each new company. This usually takes less than 24 hours. You will be notified by email upon validation. In the meantime, you can prepare your jobs as drafts.

questions.q: How many jobs can I post?
questions.a: With the free plan, you can post 1 active job. The Pro and Business plans allow you to post more jobs simultaneously. You can always save unlimited drafts. Check the 'Pricing' page for more details.

questions.q: How do I manage received applications?
questions.a: In your dashboard, go to 'Applications'. You will see all applications sorted by job. You can change the status (viewed, shortlisted, interview, accepted, rejected). The candidate will be automatically notified by email.

questions.q: Can I schedule a video interview directly from the platform?
questions.a: Yes, on the application detail page, you can generate a Jitsi video conference link in one click and send it by email to the candidate. You can also use our AI assistant to prepare personalized interview questions.

questions.q: How do I cancel my paid subscription?
questions.a: Go to your dashboard, in the subscription section, click on 'Cancel'. You can indicate the reason (optional). Your subscription will be immediately downgraded to the free plan. You will no longer be billed.

questions.q: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) via our partner Stripe. All payments are secure and in FCFA (XOF).

questions.q: Can I change plans at any time?
questions.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade. The difference will be calculated pro-rata. Annual plans offer a 20% discount.

questions.q: What happens after a cancellation?
questions.a: Your account remains active and your posted jobs remain online until they expire. You switch back to the free plan and lose access to premium features (additional jobs, boosts, etc.).

questions.q: Is my personal data protected?
questions.a: Yes. We enforce a strict privacy policy. Your information is never shared without your consent. See our 'Privacy' page for more details.

questions.q: How do I report a fraudulent job or abuse?
questions.a: On every job and every company page, you will find a 'Report' button. Select the reason and describe the problem. Our moderation team reviews each report as quickly as possible.

questions.q: Can I delete my account?
questions.a: Yes, contact us via the contact form indicating your request. We will proceed to delete your account and all associated data in accordance with the regulations.

items.title: Actoos Jobs: 5 tips to quickly land a student job
items.excerpt: Discover how to find a flexible job suited to your studies and schedule, and land a gig within days.
items.content:
Why look for a flexible student job?

As a student, balancing classes, revision and personal life is already a challenge. A flexible job allows you to earn money without sacrificing your studies. Actoos Jobs connects you with employers who understand your constraints.

1. Create a complete profile

Your profile is your showcase. Fill in your availability, skills and experiences. Recruiters look for clear and detailed profiles.

2. Set up personalised alerts

Receive offers that match your profile and area directly. You'll save valuable time in your search.

3. Apply quickly

Flexible jobs go fast. As soon as an offer interests you, send your application. On Actoos Jobs, simplified applications let you apply in a few clicks.

4. Personalise your message

Customise each application with a short sentence explaining your motivation and availability. This shows your seriousness.

5. Stay available and responsive

Employers appreciate candidates who respond quickly. Keep an eye on your notifications and confirm your availability as soon as possible.

Conclusion

With Actoos Jobs, finding a student job has never been easier. Create your profile today and discover opportunities adapted to your pace of life.

items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: the guide to flexible jobs for students
items.excerpt: Student jobs, extras, part-time: what are the differences and how to choose the one that suits you best?
items.content:
Understanding flexible jobs

A flexible job is an activity that adapts to your schedule. There are several formats: classic student job, extra gigs, part-time or casual work. Each has its advantages.

The student job

Ideal for gaining first experience while continuing your studies. Hours are generally adapted to university constraints.

Extra gigs

Perfect for those who want to work occasionally, often in catering, events or retail. You choose the gigs that interest you.

Part-time

A regular contract with reduced hours, providing stability while leaving time for studies or other activities.

Casual assignments

Short interventions, sometimes daily or weekly, ideal for supplementing income without commitment.

How to choose?

Assess your availability, financial needs and goals. On Actoos Jobs, you can filter offers by contract type and area, to find the formula that suits you.

Conclusion

Whatever your profile, Actoos Jobs helps you find the flexible job that fits perfectly into your life.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: why recruit extras through a local platform
items.excerpt: Finding qualified casual staff can be a headache. Discover how a local platform simplifies hiring extras.
items.content:
The challenge of extras

For a restaurant, event or shop, having reliable casual staff is essential. But recruiting an extra at the last minute is often difficult.

1. A pool of local candidates

By using a local platform like Actoos Jobs, you access profiles close to your establishment, available quickly.

2. Pre-qualified applications

Candidates on the platform are actively looking for casual assignments. They are motivated and ready to work.

3. Considerable time savings

No need to post ads everywhere. You publish your need and receive targeted applications within hours.

4. Flexibility as the watchword

You can recruit for an evening, a weekend or a week, without long-term commitment.

Conclusion

Recruiting extras has never been easier. Join Actoos Jobs and build your casual team with confidence.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: 3 ways to boost your application
items.excerpt: Optimize your profile and applications to stand out and get more interviews.
items.content:
Stand out on Actoos Jobs

On a job platform, competition is real. Here are three levers to make your application irresistible.

1. Complete your profile 100%

A complete profile inspires confidence. Add a professional photo, a description of your skills, experiences and availability. Recruiters are more inclined to contact a detailed profile.

2. Personalise your application messages

Avoid generic messages. Explain in two lines why this position interests you and what you can bring. This shows your motivation and seriousness.

3. Be responsive and available

Respond quickly to recruiters' messages and keep your commitments. Reliability is a highly sought-after quality, especially for flexible jobs.

Conclusion

By following these three tips, you will significantly increase your chances of landing a job via Actoos Jobs. It's up to you!
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: the 10 most in-demand jobs for extras
items.excerpt: Discover the sectors that hire the most extras and the skills needed to land these gigs.
items.content:
Extras: sought-after profiles

Extra assignments are numerous and varied. Some jobs are particularly in demand, offering regular opportunities to flexible candidates.

1. Waiter / Waitress

Catering is the top sector for extras. Knowing how to carry plates, take orders and having a sense of service are essential.

2. Bartender

For events, bars and parties, qualified bartenders are highly sought after. Speed and knowledge of cocktails are a plus.

3. Dishwasher / Kitchen assistant

Rush hours in the kitchen require reinforcements. No diploma required, but good physical stamina.

4. Host / Hostess

Ideal for trade shows, congresses and corporate events. A polished presentation and good interpersonal skills are essential.

5. Salesperson

Shops often hire extras during peak periods. Contact skills and rigour matter.

6. Security agent

For events and sensitive sites, certified agents are in high demand.

7. Handler

Loading, unloading, order picking: physical but accessible assignments.

8. Activity leader

For leisure centres, camps or family events.

9. Delivery driver

Food and parcel delivery is booming. A licence and a vehicle are often required.

10. Cleaning agent

Cleaning offices, events or commercial surfaces.

Conclusion

By highlighting your skills and availability on Actoos Jobs, you increase your chances of landing these gigs regularly.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: how to write a job ad that attracts the right profiles
items.excerpt: A well-written ad is the key to successful recruitment. Follow these tips to attract qualified candidates.
items.content:
Your ad is your first impression

On Actoos Jobs, competition among employers is real. A clear and detailed ad will set you apart.

1. A precise title

State the job and type of assignment: “Waiter extra for evening” is more effective than “Looking for staff”.

2. Describe the assignment

Explain the concrete tasks, hours and location. Candidates want to know what to expect.

3. Mention the benefits

Meals, good atmosphere, flexible hours, possibility of regular work: everything that can encourage applications.

4. Specify the required skills

Experience, licence, specific attire: be transparent to avoid bad surprises.

5. Use a human tone

Write as you would talk to a candidate. Too corporate ads put people off.

Conclusion

Take the time to craft your ad on Actoos Jobs. It's the most profitable investment for fast, quality recruitment.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: managing your time between studies and a flexible job
items.excerpt: Balancing classes, revision and work is a balancing act. Here are strategies to manage it stress-free.
items.content:
A daily challenge

Many students work to finance their studies. But juggling classes and a flexible job requires organisation.

1. Plan your week

Use a diary or app to block your class, work and revision slots. Visualise your schedule.

2. Choose a suitable job

Prioritise assignments that respect your hours. On Actoos Jobs, filter by availability to find compatible offers.

3. Communicate with your employer

Be transparent about your constraints. A good employer will understand and adapt.

4. Don't neglect your studies

Your priority remains your education. If work encroaches too much, adjust the number of hours.

5. Allow yourself rest

Overwork harms health and results. Keep time for yourself.

Conclusion

A flexible job can be an asset, provided it's well managed. Actoos Jobs helps you find the balance.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: the advantages of part-time work for students
items.excerpt: Part-time work offers regular income and experience without sacrificing studies. Find out why it's a winning option.

Find a balance

Conclusion

Part-time work is an excellent springboard. Explore offers on Actoos Jobs and find the job that suits you.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: 7 questions to ask in an interview for a flexible job
items.excerpt: Asking the right questions shows your seriousness and helps you evaluate the employer. Here are 7 essential questions.
items.content:
The interview is an exchange

A successful interview isn't just answering questions. Asking your own demonstrates interest and maturity.

1. What will my exact duties be?

This clarifies expectations and avoids misunderstandings.

2. What are the exact hours?

Essential to check compatibility with studies or other commitments.

3. Is there a trial or training period?

To know how integration will happen.

4. How are assignments scheduled?

Fixed schedule or on demand?

5. What are the possibilities for advancement?

Shows you're thinking ahead.

6. How does communication work within the team?

Important for a flexible job.

7. What is the payment process?

Frequency and terms.

Conclusion

Prepare these questions before your Actoos Jobs interview. You'll appear professional and engaged.

items.title: Actoos Jobs: how to retain your extras and reduce turnover
items.excerpt: A regular extra is a valuable asset. Discover how to build a lasting relationship with your casual staff.
items.content:
Retention: a key issue

For an employer, having reliable, experienced extras is a competitive advantage. Here's how to keep them.

1. Communicate clearly

Send schedules in advance, specify hours and tasks. Transparency reassures.

2. Value their work

A thank you, a tip, a small gesture: recognition motivates.

3. Offer regular assignments

Give priority to your usual extras before looking for new profiles.

4. Be flexible in return

Understand their constraints (studies, other work) and adapt when possible.

5. Pay on time

Fast and reliable payment is a major retention factor.

Conclusion

By treating your extras well, you build a loyal and efficient team. Actoos Jobs helps you find and manage them.

items.title: Actoos Jobs: mistakes to avoid when applying for a student job
items.excerpt: A sloppy application can ruin your chances. Here are the pitfalls to avoid to maximise your chances.
items.content:
Competition is strong

For a student job, employers often receive many applications. Avoid these mistakes to stand out.

1. Sending a generic CV

Adapt your CV to each offer. Highlight relevant skills.

2. Neglecting the application message

An empty or copy-pasted message gives a bad impression. Write two personalised sentences.

3. Ignoring availability

If the ad specifies hours, make sure you're available. Otherwise, no point applying.

4. Poor presentation

Check your profile photo and contact details.

5. Not following up

If no response after a few days, a polite follow-up can make the difference.

Conclusion

Take care with every application on Actoos Jobs. It's the first step to an interview.

items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: differences between CDI, CDD, interim and flexible job
items.excerpt: Understanding the different contract types helps you choose the formula that suits you.
items.content:
Different statuses

Each contract type has advantages and constraints. Here's a summary to clarify.

CDI

Open-ended contract, stable but less flexible.

CDD

Fixed-term contract, for replacement or increased activity.

Interim

Assignment through an agency, often short and renewable.

Flexible job

One-off or regular assignments without long-term commitment, ideal for students or those seeking flexibility.

Which to choose?

If you prioritise flexibility, a flexible job is for you. Actoos Jobs mainly offers this type of opportunity.

Conclusion

Learn about your rights and choose the contract that fits your situation.
items.author: Actoos Jobs Team

items.title: Actoos Jobs: optimise your candidate profile to receive more offers

2. Use a professional photo

3. Write a punchy summary

4. Update regularly

Add new experiences and skills.

5. Enable geolocation

Local offers will be more relevant.

Conclusion

Take time to refine your profile. You'll receive more suitable offers.

On Actoos Jobs, reputation is a competitive asset. Take care of it.

cgu.subtitle: The rules governing the use of our platform.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.content:
These Terms and Conditions of Use (hereinafter "TCU") aim to define the conditions of availability of the Actoos website and its associated services, as well as the terms of access and use of the service by the User.

Any use of the site implies unreserved acceptance and compliance with all these TCU. They constitute the contract between the service and the User.

sections.title: 2. Access to the service
sections.content:
Access to the Actoos website is free and open to any person with an internet connection. Access and communication costs are borne exclusively by the User.

The site is accessible 24/7, except for scheduled interruptions or force majeure. Actoos reserves the right to temporarily suspend access for maintenance operations without prior notice.

sections.title: 3. Registration and user account
sections.content: To access certain features (posting offers, applying, messaging), the User must create a personal account by providing accurate and up-to-date information. The User is solely responsible for the confidentiality of their login and password. Any fraudulent use of the account must be immediately reported to {{email}}. Actoos cannot be held liable for loss or damage resulting from unauthorized use of the account.

sections.title: 4. User commitments
sections.content:
The User agrees to:
• Not publish any content that is illegal, defamatory, discriminatory or contrary to public order.
• Not impersonate a third party or provide false information.
• Not disrupt the proper functioning of the site (viruses, spam, hacking, etc.).
• Respect the intellectual property rights of Actoos and third parties.

Any breach may result in the immediate suspension or deletion of the account, without prejudice to legal action.

sections.title: 5. Job offers and applications
sections.content:
Employers are responsible for the content of the job offers they publish (title, description, salary, etc.). Actoos reserves the right to moderate or remove any offer that does not comply with current legislation or these TCU.

Applicants are responsible for the information they provide (CV, cover letter). Actoos does not guarantee the accuracy of the offers or the delivery of a favorable outcome to an application. No contractual employment relationship is established between the User and Actoos through the posting or consultation of an offer.

sections.title: 6. Subscriptions and payments
sections.content:
Some services are offered on a paid subscription basis (Pro, Business plans). Prices can be consulted on the dedicated page and may be modified with reasonable notice. Payment is made online by credit card via a secure provider. Actoos does not store any banking data.

The User may cancel their subscription at any time. Refund conditions are specified upon subscription. In case of payment default, Actoos reserves the right to suspend access to paid features.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
sections.content:
All elements of the site (texts, logos, graphics, source code, database) are the exclusive property of Actoos or its partners and are protected by intellectual property laws. Any unauthorized reproduction, modification, adaptation or exploitation is strictly prohibited.

Trademarks and logos appearing on the site are registered and protected. The User has no rights over these elements beyond simply viewing the site.

sections.title: 8. Personal data
sections.content: The personal data collected is processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, accessible at any time on the site. In accordance with data protection laws and the GDPR, the User has the right to access, rectify and delete their data. To exercise these rights, contact us at {{email}}.

sections.title: 9. Liability and limitations
sections.content:
Actoos makes every effort to provide a quality service, but cannot be held liable in the event of service interruption, data loss or indirect damages resulting from the use of the site. The site may contain hypertext links to third-party sites, over which Actoos has no control and for which it disclaims all responsibility.

The User uses the site at their own risk. Actoos cannot be held responsible for the consequences of a misinterpretation of an offer or an application.

sections.title: 10. Modification of the TCU
sections.content: Actoos reserves the right to modify these TCU at any time. Users will be informed by any appropriate means (email, notification on the site). The modified version will come into force upon its posting online. Continued use of the site after that date constitutes acceptance of the new TCU.

sections.title: 11. Applicable law and jurisdiction
sections.content: These TCU are governed by the law applicable at Actoos' registered office. In the event of a dispute, the parties will endeavor to find an amicable solution before any legal action. Failing that, the dispute will be submitted to the competent courts.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Learn how we use cookies to improve your experience.
cookies.contactText: You can contact us at any time with any questions about our cookie policy: {{email}}

whatIsCookie.title: 1. What is a cookie?
whatIsCookie.content: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, mobile) when you browse a website. It stores information about your navigation and improves your user experience. Cookies do not contain viruses and do not allow access to unauthorized personal information.

subsections.title: Strictly necessary cookies
subsections.content:
These are essential for the proper functioning of the site. Without them, certain features (login, security, cart) could not be provided. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

Examples: session cookie, consent preference cookie.

subsections.title: Performance and analytics cookies
subsections.content:
They help us understand how users interact with the site by collecting anonymous data about pages visited, time spent, possible errors. These cookies allow us to continuously improve our services.

We use Google Analytics with IP anonymization.

subsections.title: Functionality cookies
subsections.content:
They allow us to remember your preferences (language, country, currency, login details) to personalize your experience. The site installs them only if you have chosen these options.

Examples: language cookie, country cookie, currency cookie.

subsections.title: Targeting and advertising cookies
subsections.content: Currently, Actoos does not use third-party advertising cookies. If this were to change, you would be informed and explicit consent would be requested before any activation.

thirdParty.title: 3. Third-party cookies
thirdParty.content: Some services we use (hosting, audience analysis, embedded videos) may place their own cookies. We have no direct control over these cookies. We invite you to consult the privacy policy of these third-party services to learn more. Currently, only Google Analytics may place third-party cookies.

manageCookies.title: 4. Managing cookies
manageCookies.content:
On your first visit to our site, a banner informs you about the use of cookies and allows you to customize your choices. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking on the 'Cookie settings' link at the bottom of each page, or by using your browser settings (see next section).

Strictly necessary cookies cannot be disabled as they are essential for the site to function.

browserSettings.title: 5. Browser settings
browserSettings.content:
You can also control cookies directly from your browser settings:
• Google Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies and other site data.
• Mozilla Firefox: Options > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data.
• Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Cookies and website data.
• Microsoft Edge: Settings > Cookies and site permissions > Cookies and data stored.

Disabling all cookies may cause the site to function incorrectly.

changes.title: 6. Updates to this policy
changes.content: We may modify this cookie policy at any time. Changes take effect as soon as they are published on this page. We encourage you to review it regularly.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.content: For any questions or requests for further information about our cookie policy, you can write to us at the following address: {{email}}

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal data.
privacyPolicy.contactText: For any questions about the protection of your data, you can write to us at: {{email}}

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.content: This privacy policy describes how Actoos collects, uses and protects the personal information you provide when using our platform. We are committed to complying with current regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
sections.content:
We collect the following data:
• Identification data: first name, last name, email address, phone number (optional).
• Professional data: CV, cover letters, experience, skills.
• Browsing data: IP address, pages viewed, visit duration.

This data is collected when you create your account, submit an application or job offer, or simply browse the site.

sections.title: 3. Use of data
sections.content:
Your data is used to:
• Enable the proper functioning of the service (account creation, job posting, connecting recruiters and candidates).
• Improve user experience (browsing analysis, content personalization).
• Send service-related communications (job alerts, newsletters) if you have consented.
• Meet our legal obligations.

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
sections.content:
Your personal data is strictly confidential and is never sold to third parties. It may be shared with:
• Recruiters, when you apply for an offer (your public CV information is accessible to them).
• Our technical service providers (hosting, email sending) bound by confidentiality agreements.
• Competent authorities, if required by law.

You can modify the visibility of your profile at any time in your settings.

sections.title: 5. Data security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction: encryption of sensitive data, restricted data access by our employees, regular security audits.

sections.title: 6. Data retention
sections.content: Your data is retained for the entire duration of your account. If you delete your account, your data is deleted within a maximum of 30 days, unless legal retention obligations apply (e.g. invoices, contractual proof). CVs and applications are deleted as soon as the associated account is deleted.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.content: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights: • Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data. • Right of rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data. • Right to erasure: request deletion of your data (within legal limits). • Right to object: refuse the processing of your data on legitimate grounds. • Right to portability: receive your data in a structured format. To exercise these rights, contact us at {{email}}.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.content: The site uses cookies to improve browsing and analyze traffic. You can manage your preferences at any time via the cookie banner. Cookies strictly necessary for the site to function cannot be disabled.

sections.title: 9. Changes to the policy
sections.content: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Users will be informed of major changes by email or via a notification on the site. We invite you to consult this page regularly.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Actoos, simply.

questions.q: What is Actoos?
questions.a: Actoos is an online recruitment platform that connects companies and candidates internationally. We simplify job searches and job postings, regardless of the country or region.

questions.q: Is registration free?
questions.a: Yes, registration as a candidate or company is completely free. Paid options (Pro, Business) are available for companies that want more features.

questions.q: Who can use Actoos?
questions.a: Anyone looking for a job or any company/recruiter wishing to hire. The platform is multilingual and accessible worldwide.

questions.q: How do I apply for a job?
questions.a: Create a candidate account, complete your profile and upload your CV. You can then apply to the offers that interest you with a single click.

questions.q: Is my profile visible to all companies?
questions.a: You are in control: your profile can be public (visible to recruiters) or private (visible only when you apply). Manage this in your privacy settings.

questions.q: How can I improve my chances of being hired?
questions.a: Complete your profile 100%, add a professional photo, detail your experiences and skills, and personalize your cover letters.

questions.q: How do I post a job offer?
questions.a: Create a company account, get your identity verified, then use the posting form. Your offer will be visible to thousands of candidates.

questions.q: How much does posting cost?
questions.a: The Free plan offers a first posting. The Pro and Business plans give access to more simultaneous offers, boosts and increased visibility. Check the Pricing page for details.

questions.q: Can I manage multiple companies with a single account?
questions.a: Yes, you can create or join several companies and switch between them from your dashboard.

questions.q: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.a: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard) via a secure payment partner. Prices are generally displayed in CFA Francs (XOF) or your local currency.

questions.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
questions.a: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard, in the Subscription section. The cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period.

questions.q: Can I change plans (monthly → annual)?
questions.a: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade or change your billing cycle at any time. Price adjustments are calculated automatically.

questions.q: How do I contact support?
questions.a: Write to us at contact@actoos.com or use the contact form on the site. We respond within 24 business hours.

questions.q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
questions.a: Click on 'Forgot password' from the login page. You will receive an email to reset it.

questions.q: How do I report a problem or a fraudulent offer?
questions.a: Use the report button (flag) on each offer or profile. Our moderation team reviews all reports promptly.
